svg.title: Walking time to the nearest public school and primary health care unit, Recife
svg.desc: Two maps of Recife covered by hexagons coloured by the walking time from each cell to the nearest public school, on the left, and to the nearest primary health care unit, on the right. Almost every inhabited cell is within 15 minutes of a public school; health units are farther apart, and a scattering of cells, mostly in the south and the west, are 15 to 30 minutes from the nearest one.

g.text: 1,107 hexagonal cells 500 m apart with their population (Censo 2022); 937 public schools
(INEP) and 511 primary health care units (CNES) in Recife and up to 10 km around it.
Blank: no residents, or more than 30 minutes
Walking time to the nearest school and health unit, Recife
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract of 2026-11-01.
Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022. Schools: INEP. Health units: CNES, Ministério da Saúde.
